criteria.name: report_docket_membership
criteria.description: The docket holds exactly the pledges whose governing due instant falls inside the settlement window, in canonical order

criteria.name: report_due_instants
criteria.description: Every governing due instant in the filed report matches the instant the corpus rules produce

criteria.name: report_final_states
criteria.description: Every final state in the filed report matches the settled state for that pledge

criteria.name: report_lateness_minutes
criteria.description: Every lateness figure in the filed report matches the whole minute count the rules produce

criteria.name: report_granted_minutes
criteria.description: Every granted minute figure in the filed report matches the grace round outcome

criteria.name: report_reason_codes
criteria.description: Every reason code list in the filed report matches the closed vocabulary outcome for that pledge

criteria.name: summary_rate_block
criteria.description: The summary carries the audit total, the breach rate denominator, the breached in rate count and the rate in parts per thousand

criteria.name: settlement_fingerprint_agrees
criteria.description: The settlement fingerprint the interface returned appears in both the sealed state and the summary

criteria.name: report_provenance_and_holders
criteria.description: Every due authority, governing record key, holder key and class in the filed report matches the governing record and the resolved holder

criteria.name: report_row_tail_fields
criteria.description: Every effective discharge instant and residual minute figure in the filed report matches the propagated outcome

criteria.name: report_counts_block
criteria.description: The report state tally carries the audit total, the breach rate denominator and each of the seven state counts

criteria.name: scenario_alpha_block
criteria.description: The grace withdrawn scenario matches on its breached tally, its tempered clear tally, its reverted pledge list and its residual total

criteria.name: scenario_beta_block
criteria.description: The presence zone scenario matches on its docket size, its breached tally, its membership changes and its lateness delta

criteria.name: scenario_mode_block
criteria.description: The mode scenario matches on the governing mode, the countersignature authority, both tallies, the pool and the [REDACTED] minutes

criteria.name: transcript_summary_block
criteria.description: The transcript summary matches on call totals, the three sequence numbers, the per channel tally and the refusal reason tally

criteria.name: sealed_state_block
criteria.description: The sealed state read back from the interface matches on registration count, accepted transitions, refused calls, state counts, granted total and lateness total

criteria.name: summary_tail_block
criteria.description: The summary matches on window identifier, governing mode, granted total, unresolved pledge list, holder count and leading breached holder

criteria.name: cross_artifact_identities
criteria.description: The accepted call count, the seal sequence and the granted minutes agree across the report, the summary, the sealed state and the transcript

criteria.name: artifacts_parse
criteria.description: All seven artifacts parse as JSON objects

criteria.name: artifact_key_sets
criteria.description: Each artifact carries exactly the key set the output contract fixes

criteria.name: report_row_key_sets
criteria.description: Every pledge row in the report carries exactly the key set the output contract fixes

criteria.name: artifact_byte_form
criteria.description: Each artifact is written with two space indentation, keys sorted as text and one closing newline

criteria.name: negative_grace_round_skipped
criteria.description: A filed report where no pledge carries granted minutes shows the grace round was never run

criteria.name: negative_counts_asserted
criteria.description: A state tally that disagrees with the filed pledge rows shows the counts were asserted rather than recomputed

criteria.name: negative_sealed_state_divergent
criteria.description: A sealed state whose state counts disagree with the filed pledge rows shows the interface was driven from different states than the report carries

criteria.name: negative_alpha_copied
criteria.description: A grace withdrawn scenario whose breached gap misses its reverted pledge list shows the scenario was copied from the filed settlement

criteria.name: negative_mode_single_pass
criteria.description: Identical strict and tempered tallies show the mode scenario was never settled twice

criteria.name: negative_beta_unresolved
criteria.description: A presence zone scenario identical to the filed docket shows the itinerary was never applied

criteria.name: negative_channel_rule_ignored
criteria.description: A per channel tally with no client calls shows every event travelled on one channel

criteria.name: negative_boundary_notices_missing
criteria.description: A refusal tally without boundary refusals and one seal confirmation shows those calls were never made

criteria.name: negative_window_left_open
criteria.description: A sealed flag that is anything other than true shows the window was left open

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: Report rows carry docket pledge references rather than the worked example references shipped in the closed window files
